facts.fact: The Ministry of Information and Communication Infrastructure issued the National Broadband Policy 2020-2024 (BP-2024) in June 2020 for a five-year period ending in 2024, setting a 5 Mbps minimum for every user, 75% of homes with affordable 5 Mbps by 2022, near-100% by 2023 and 4G coverage of at least 85% of the population by 2024; the document names no successor.

note: No delivery fact: the document names a Financing and investment gap and a monitoring chapter, but ties no money to the plan and reports no figures against its targets (capture truncated before sections 12-13).
